newsitem.title: USA: Food Lion judge to instruct jury Tuesday morning.
newsitem.headline: Food Lion judge to instruct jury Tuesday morning.

text.p: U.S. District Judge Carlton Tilley on Monday said he expected the closing arguments over punitive damages in Food Lion Inc's FDNLA.O lawsuit against ABC television network to last the rest of the session and that he would give instructions to the jury on Tuesday morning.
Opposing lawyers in the case broke for lunch and were scheduled to begin final arguments at 1345 EST/1845 GMT on Monday.

Walt Disney Co's ABC network and four of its news producers were found late last year to have committed fraud, trespass and breach of loyalty in undercover reporting for a 1992 hidden-camera story on the supermarket chain's food-handling practices.
The jury is to decide how much Food Lion, a unit of Belgian retailer ETS Delhaize Freres et Cie "LE LION" SA, is to be awarded in addition to the $1,400 it was already given in compenstory damages.

According to news reports, Food Lion is seeking as much as $2 billion in punitive damages but the company has declined comment. The company's lawyers are expected to suggest an amount during closing arguments, though the decision for any award would be made by the jury.
